假设的稳健性\"}],\"opposing_view\":{\"summary\":\"另一侧更重视实施条件与成本，认为行动节奏需权衡经济代价。\",\"main_evidence\":\"材料提到自然碳循环仍在运作，且归因依赖模型假设，提示不确定性。\",\"boundary\":\"但材料未给出具体成本数据，也未否定额外排放会增强温室效应这一机制。\"}}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794554327,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":813,"prompt_tokens":9053,"total_tokens":9866,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":6144}}}
